tools.name: referralcandy_list_campaigns
tools.description: List the campaigns in the account with their IDs, names, join URLs and state (ACTIVE, PAUSED or STOPPED). Call this first: other tools take campaign IDs. GET /campaigns.json.

tools.name: referralcandy_list_segments
tools.description: List the static contact segments with their IDs. Dynamic segments are not included. Use a segment ID with the segment tools and referralcandy_signup_advocate. GET /segments.json.

tools.name: referralcandy_list_contacts
tools.description: Read contacts enrolled in a campaign, with purchase history and unsubscribe state. Page with id (lowest contact ID to start at) and limit (max 100). GET /contacts.json.

tools.name: referralcandy_get_referrer
tools.description: Look up who referred a customer, if anyone. Returns the referrer's email and the campaign ID, or null. GET /referrer.json.

tools.name: referralcandy_list_referrals
tools.description: List referred purchases in a time window (UNIX seconds). Filter by the advocate's email or only those still in the review period. Recent referrals appear a few minutes after purchase. GET /referrals.json.

tools.name: referralcandy_list_rewards
tools.description: List earned advocate rewards, first 200 matches. Filter by advocate email, status (pending_fulfillment or delivered), type (cash, coupon, custom or none), campaign, or start after a reward ID. GET /rewards.json.

tools.name: referralcandy_list_reward_purchases
tools.description: List the referred purchases that a reward is based on. GET /reward_purchases.json.

tools.name: referralcandy_signup_advocate
tools.description: Add a contact and try to enroll them in every campaign. Returns the advocate's referral link and sharing page for each enrolled campaign. Check enrollments: a contact can exist without any enrollment. POST /signup.json.

tools.name: referralcandy_record_purchase
tools.description: Register a completed order so ReferralCandy can detect referrals and reward advocates. order_timestamp must be within 10 minutes of the buyer's visit to the purchase-complete page. Sending the same external_reference_id twice is deduplicated. POST /purchase.json.

tools.name: referralcandy_update_referral
tools.description: Mark a referred customer's purchase as returned. The referral is disregarded and no reward is paid. By default the advocate is emailed. POST /referral.json.

tools.name: referralcandy_add_segment_contact
tools.description: Add an existing contact to a static segment. The contact then enrolls in every campaign that targets the segment. The contact must already exist (use referralcandy_signup_advocate for a new one). POST /segment_contacts.json.

tools.name: referralcandy_remove_segment_contact
tools.description: Remove a contact from a static segment. The contact is unenrolled from campaigns that no longer match them. DELETE /segment_contacts.json.

tools.name: referralcandy_send_invite
tools.description: Send the welcome email to a contact who is enrolled in a campaign. No email is sent if the contact is not enrolled. POST /invite.json.

tools.name: referralcandy_update_reward_status
tools.description: Set a custom reward to pending_fulfillment or delivered, for example after you ship the reward. It can also move a delivered reward back to pending_fulfillment. POST /rewards.json.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: referralcandy_list_campaigns, referralcandy_get_referrer, referralcandy_list_referrals, referralcandy_list_rewards, referralcandy_signup_advocate · Private data: referralcandy_list_segments, referralcandy_list_contacts, referralcandy_signup_advocate, referralcandy_record_purchase, referralcandy_add_segment_contact, referralcandy_remove_segment_contact, referralcandy_send_invite · Public sink: referralcandy_get_referrer, referralcandy_list_referrals, referralcandy_list_rewards, referralcandy_signup_advocate, referralcandy_record_purchase, referralcandy_update_referral, referralcandy_add_segment_contact, referralcandy_send_invite, referralcandy_update_reward_status · Destructive: referralcandy_remove_segment_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: referralcandy_list_campaigns, referralcandy_get_referrer, referralcandy_list_referrals, referralcandy_list_rewards, referralcandy_signup_advocate · Private data: referralcandy_list_segments, referralcandy_list_contacts, referralcandy_signup_advocate, referralcandy_record_purchase, referralcandy_add_segment_contact, referralcandy_remove_segment_contact, referralcandy_send_invite · Public sink: referralcandy_get_referrer, referralcandy_list_referrals, referralcandy_list_rewards, referralcandy_signup_advocate, referralcandy_record_purchase, referralcandy_update_referral, referralcandy_add_segment_contact, referralcandy_send_invite, referralcandy_update_reward_status · Destructive: referralcandy_remove_segment_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
